name: Ubai Again ~Hito no Onna, Mata Urimasu~
original_name: 奪again ～人の妻、また売ります～
source:
He is an actor, cameraman and scullery maid. Normally, he shoots videos and photographs, focusing on netori/netorare.

However, behind the scenes, this company is connected to a dangerous organization, and is involved in the business of providing women to like-minded people who enjoy true cuckoldry.

Today, again, women with various circumstances come to the company. It is his job to take images to sell them and make his clients embrace them. 

It has been six months since he started taking on the behind-the-scenes work alone. However, his colleague, Manami, points out that it may be difficult to make either of the women he will be taking care of this time fall in love with him.

He is impressed by Gen's imposing behavior and reacts to Manami's words, “Gen would have taken the women for himself". He decides to get more actively involved in the cuckold business in order to make the women fall in love with him.

[From [url=https://www.ubai.org/ubai/ubai_again/ubai_story.html]official site[/url]]
translation:
他既是演员、摄影师，也是杂役。平时，他拍摄以寝取和被寝取为主题的视频与照片。

然而在幕后，这家公司与危险组织相连，经营着向同好者提供女性的生意，满足他们真正的绿帽癖。

今天，又有身负各种遭遇的女性来到公司。他的工作是拍摄她们的影像，将其出售，再让客户与她们发生关系。

他独自接手幕后工作已经半年了。但同事真奈美指出，这次负责照顾的两名女性恐怕都很难爱上他。

他对源强势的行事风格印象深刻，又想起真奈美的话：“源肯定会把那些女人占为己有。”于是，他决定更积极地参与绿帽生意，好让这些女人爱上自己。
